title: The Five Fathers: Five Discrete Degrees of Divine Accommodation
description: A single chain of emanation by which Divine love and wisdom proceed through five successive Fathers — Father of Greatness, Third Ambassador, Jesus the Radiance, Mind of Light, and Form of Light — each producing its own threefold operation, until the inmost Divine reaches the soul leaving the body and clothes it with the garments of light. They are not five Gods but the one Lord in five discrete degrees of accommodation.
